script.title: BOOKING THE PLUMBER
script.story_hook: A leaking sink means one call to a plumber.
script.intro_zh: 水槽漏水，一通電話請水管工上門。
script.welcome_en: Hi there, welcome back! Today we're calling a plumber about a leak at home.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎回來！今天我們打電話找水管工，處理家裡的漏水。
script.outro: That's everything for today! Listen again and repeat along. Until next time!
script.outro_zh: 今天就到這裡！再聽一遍，跟著重複。我們下次見！
script.practice_intro_en: Now it's your turn — echo each line with me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在換你——跟著我一句一句複誦。
script.char_a_description: a stocky white man in his early forties with a salt-and-pepper beard and receding sandy hair, wearing a plaid lumberjack shirt and reading glasses, crouched under a kitchen sink holding a soaked towel
script.char_b_description: a bright-eyed East Asian woman in her late twenties with a straight black bob, a headset perched over one ear, a mustard-yellow polo shirt with a company logo, typing quickly on a keyboard while she talks
script.youtube_title: 【🔧🚰廚房漏水怎麼辦】「出場檢測費」怎麼問？約水管工超實用英文｜🚿Plumber Appointment English
script.youtube_title_en: “There's a Service Call Fee” — Scheduling a Plumber for a Leaky Sink
script.youtube_description:
家裡漏水，英文卻不知道怎麼約師傅上門？這通打給水管公司的電話對話幫你全部走過一遍！報修狀況、確認到府時段、詢問出場檢測費、留下地址，還順便問了洗碗機。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就敢開口用。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Got a leak but no words for booking a plumber? This phone-call conversation walks you through it all: describing the problem, picking a service window, asking about the call-out fee, and sharing an address — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA. Repeat every line in the second half and make the call today.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🔧約水管工英文｜報修狀況・確認時段・檢測費用｜一通電話就搞定｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
廚房突然漏水，急著找師傅卻不知怎麼開口？
到府時段、出場費用，用英文要怎麼問？

這一集帶大家走進一通報修電話，跟著屋主從描述漏水狀況、確認八到十點的到府時段，到詢問檢測費、留下地址與電話，全程都用自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🚰 描述狀況：例如「I have a leak under my kitchen sink.」、「Is it dripping fast?」。
🕐 時段與費用：例如「The plumber gives an eight to ten window.」、「Just so you know, there's a service call fee.」。
📋 留下資料與加問：例如「Just your address and a good phone number.」、「Do you fix dishwashers too?」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

看完記得存下這通對話，哪天漏水真的用得上！
script.thumbnail_expression: worried but relieved on the phone
script.thumbnail_action: holding a phone under the kitchen sink while pointing at a wet pipe

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I have a leak under my kitchen sink.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ hæv ə lik ˈʌndər maɪ ˈkɪtʃɪn sɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我家廚房水槽下方在漏水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, that's frustrating. Is it dripping fast?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ðæts frʌˈstreɪtɪŋ ɪz ɪt ˈdrɪpɪŋ fæst/
dialogue.zh: 噢，不，那真惱人。滴得很快嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just slowly, but the cabinet's getting wet.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ˈsloʊli bət ðə ˈkæbɪnəz ˈɡɛtɪŋ wɛt/
dialogue.zh: 滴得慢，但櫃子已經開始濕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay. We can send someone tomorrow morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ wi kæn sɛnd ˈsʌmˌwʌn təˈmɑroʊ ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好的，我們明天上午可以派人過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 上午可以。確切是幾點呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The plumber gives an eight to ten window.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈplʌmər ɡɪvz ən eɪt tə tɛn ˈwɪnˌdoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 水管工會提供八點到十點之間上門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's great, I'll be home all morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɡreɪt aɪl bi hoʊm ɔl ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我整個上午都會在家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. Just so you know, there's a service call fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt dʒʌst soʊ ju noʊ ðɛrz ə ˈsɜrvɪs kɔl fi/
dialogue.zh: 很好。先跟你說一聲，有一筆出場檢測費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is that, if you don't mind me asking?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ðæt ɪf ju doʊnt maɪnd mi ˈæskɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 請問那個多少錢——如果不介意我問的話？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's sixty, and it covers the first hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈsɪksti ænd ɪt ˈkʌvɚz ðə fɜrst ˈaʊər/
dialogue.zh: 六十塊，涵蓋第一個小時的工時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, fair enough. What do you need from me?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ fɛr ɪˈnʌf wɑt du ju nid frʌm mi/
dialogue.zh: 好，很合理。需要我提供什麼資訊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just your address and a good phone number.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst jɔr əˈdrɛs ænd ə ɡʊd foʊn ˈnʌmˌbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 只要你的地址和一組能連繫的電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, it's forty-two Elm Street, apartment B.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ɪts ˈfɔrti tu ɛm strit əˈpɑrtmənt bi/
dialogue.zh: 好的，榆樹街四十二號，B 號公寓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. You'll get a text when we're close.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt jul ɡɛt ə tɛkst wɛn wɪrz kloʊs/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。師傅快到你會收到簡訊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing — do you fix dishwashers too?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr θɪŋ du ju fɪks dɪʃˈwɑʃɚz tu/
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事——你們也修洗碗機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, just mention it when he arrives, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs dʒʌst ˈmɛnʃən ɪt wɛn hi əˈraɪvz oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 有的，等他到場時順口提一下就好？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will do. Thanks for sorting this out so fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl du θæŋks fɚ ˈsɔrtɪŋ ðɪs aʊt soʊ fæst/
dialogue.zh: 我們會。謝謝你這麼快幫我安排好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're all set. See you tomorrow morning!
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊrz ɔl sɛt si ju təˈmɑroʊ ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 都安排好了。明天上午見！
